justification: Standard: deterministic proof/plan code for served law citations (DQ-145), a publish-time DB gate and an extractor fix used for every council. This PR makes no live write; every plan is a dry run checked by its own re-deriving verifier. Not Critical: no production data changes here; the migration and plans are applied separately with backups.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_same_place_duplicates.py tests/test_sepp_complete_unit.py tests/test_sepp_ref_fix.py tests/test_page_evidence.py tests/test_dcp_doubled_chars.py tests/test_sepp_marker_blind.py
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a duplicate at another place or a whole Part is listed; codes whose words differ are cited as one; a dropped place or invented word cap passes the verifier; a heading on two candidate pages picks one; a doubled glyph is read twice; a multi-place label with an internal id is shown; a long clause is cut instead of folded
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutations run 2026-10-17: ref match without the whole-Part guard -> test_same_words_elsewhere_are_kept FAILED; identical-text condition removed -> 5 tests FAILED in test_sepp_complete_unit.py; heading '== 1' changed to '>= 1' first SURVIVED (27 passed), so test_heading_on_two_word_pages_stays_unresolved was added and the mutation then FAILED. Verifier tamper checks: dropping a place, a single-code label and a mode swap each reported a mismatch. test_doubled_line_is_read_once asserts the raw defect first (pdfplumber reads the doubled line interleaved).

pre_impl.existing_data: sepp_complete_unit decide/verify, sepp_ref_fix label grammar, page_evidence prove/verify, withhold_state_paraphrase.py, apply_sepp_marker_blind.py, apply_page_evidence.py, migrations 079/111/112 trigger style
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The Campbelltown doubled text is not a colour problem in pdfplumber: both copies are black fills (only the stroke differs), so a white-colour filter removed nothing; pdfplumber's own dedupe_chars removes it. The '17 duplicate groups' were 3 groups touching DQ-145 (20 same-place rows fleet-wide). '~30 unresolved council rows' measured 7 (22 are not_found, 3 too_short).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Adds a same-words mode and a whole-clause cap to the existing decider, a heading tie-break to prove(), dedupe in the extractor and a DB trigger; existing modes unchanged (earlier plans re-verify 45/45 and 4/5 -- the 5th, 17568, now re-derives under the same-words rule, which is the intended drop of the own-label shortcut).

functions.name: same_place_groups
functions.input: served rows with doc, text, key, ref, page
functions.output: groups of rows that are one rule at one place

functions.name: decide_smallest_unit (same-words branch, max_words)
functions.input: row text, law snapshot, context, word cap
functions.output: recopy citing every identical place, or a refusal

functions.name: same_words_label / state_clause_label / stateClauseLabel
functions.input: the clause label of each place holding the same words
functions.output: 'Section X; same words in Y, Z' accepted only when every part is clause-shaped

functions.name: row_heading / heading_pages / prove(heading)
functions.input: the row text and every page of its chapter PDF
functions.output: the one page holding the words and the row's section number
functions.if_none: no heading, or not exactly one page -> unresolved

functions.name: _drop_doubled_chars
functions.input: one pdfplumber page of a council chapter PDF
functions.output: page without glyphs printed twice over themselves

functions.name: FormattedProvisionText fold
functions.input: the served rule text of one card
functions.output: text over 600 words folded with 'Show full clause (N words)'
functions.if_none: null text counts 0 words, no fold

values.read_at: largest of the 6 refused clauses is 1,398 words (sec.2.82)
the old re-copy cap; 36 served state rows already exceed it

queries.where_clause: is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND (v2_provision_type IS NULL OR <> 'TOC')
queries.if_wrong: withhold_state_paraphrase.py refuses unless every listed id is current in the named council

queries.purpose: chapters serving rules, for the fleet measure
queries.where_clause: reg.is_active AND r2_current_path IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS a served row of the chapter

break_it.scenario: the same standard sits in several codes with slightly different words (and vs or)
break_it.what_happens: refused ambiguous_unit; the row keeps the citation-not-yet-checked mark
break_it.how: every smallest covering unit must have identical normalised tokens

break_it.scenario: the same words are on several pages and the section number is on none or several of them
break_it.what_happens: the row stays unresolved and nothing is written
break_it.how: heading_pages must return exactly one page

break_it.scenario: white text on a dark banner is real text
break_it.what_happens: kept: dedupe only removes a glyph repeated at the same spot in the same font
break_it.how: pdfplumber dedupe_chars, not a colour filter

break_it.scenario: a script inserts an unproven state-law row as served
break_it.what_happens: the INSERT fails with a check_violation error

break_it.scenario: one of the chapters serving rules cannot be downloaded or opened during the fleet measure
break_it.what_happens: that PDF is recorded with an error and the run continues
break_it.how: per-PDF try/except writes an error field and counts errors in the TOTAL line
break_it.repro: TOTAL line of scripts/measure_doubled_chars.py prints errors=N

break_it.scenario: two rows re-copy to the same clause (43931/43939)
break_it.what_happens: 43939 refused number_missing; the apply duplicate guard refuses any such pair
break_it.repro: duplicate_problems on the whole-clause plan returns []

mutation_analysis: Executed for three rules (see falsifiable_check.observed_red); one survivor found and closed with a new test.
residual_risk: Cross-review (pre-push skips diffs over 512 KB because of data files) was run by hand twice on a code-only staged diff in a fresh detached worktree at origin/main, gpt-5.6-sol. Round 1, 5 findings, all ACCEPTED and fixed: empty labels counted as one place; heading number anywhere on the page; gate missed text changes on served rows and council-to-state flips (now a deferred constraint trigger); case-sensitive same-words check in TS; every dedupe error swallowed (now AttributeError only). Round 2, 3 findings, all ACCEPTED and fixed: same page alone treated as same place (dropped: 20 -> 15 rows); prose like Control 6.5 taken as heading (now top 40 words + more reference words); timestamp refresh kept a stale proof (now needs new time AND new evidence path). Round 3 (pre-push, advisory), 4 findings: empty-text rows grouped ACCEPTED (skipped); two councils sharing a document id ACCEPTED (council in the key); 'Chapter 6.5 overview' at a page top REJECTED -- a page whose top names the section and that holds the rule's words is the intended evidence, and the 6 live proofs were checked by hand (key-site headers); AttributeError inside dedupe swallowed ACCEPTED (hasattr check, real failures propagate). Round 4 (pre-push), 1 finding: a proven council row turned into state law kept its council proof ACCEPTED (proof voided on that flip). Round 5 (pre-push), 3 findings: text change that blanks both evidence fields kept the proof ACCEPTED (both must be non-null and new; 9/9 on Postgres 17); stale Ashfield duplicate list still committed after the rule was tightened ACCEPTED (file removed; Ashfield has no same-place duplicates now); 'Chapter 6.5' heading REJECTED again, same reason as round 3. The fold sits in the shared rule-text renderer; a card that renders state-law text another way is not folded. The Campbelltown Part 3 re-read through the pipeline is refused by its own page-loss guard (page 41 left out by the reader, twice), so its 28 rows stay marked. Wollongong 137988 stays unresolved (heading 10.2 is on page 8 only). Migration 113 will refuse sync or one-off scripts that insert unproven served state rows -- intended.
